name: roster-change-runs-review
invariant: Equal gate conclusions never reuse a review across a roster change: a fresh result equal to the one a review took is equivalent for a review of the same roster (empty/conclusions_unchanged), not for another executor of the same family or an added member (found/review_input_changed); a roster with an executor the registry does not hold is never recorded (could_not_run/reviewer_not_independent) (13 roster identity; 06 rule 3).
